messages.subject: mirtCAT 0.5 is on CRAN
parts:
The package has some pretty notable changes, listed in the NEWS files (https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/blob/master/NEWS.md), but overall provides a cleaner and more stable build compared to previous versions. There will be an accompanying JSS paper released soon as well, once the final edits have been made by the copy editor. Feel free to email me if you would like a pre-published version. Cheers.

Phil
